review_scope: Independent answer- and history-blind review of the ten randomized worksheet items.

items.reason: In each inverted clause, the subject follows the verb: records is plural (are), and report is singular (is).
The number of copies takes singular is; a number of readers takes plural are.
Every guest is singular and receives; the compound subject Maya and Theo is plural and prepare.
At x = 8 the product is 8(11) = 88; larger allowed integers exceed 88.
For x = 9, (9 + 6)(9 + 1) = 15(10) = 150; the other offered values fail.
The denominator is positive throughout the domain. Cross-multiplying yields 10x >= 7x + 21, or x >= 7, so the minimum is 7.
Coach is singular and checks; players is plural and practice. The intervening near-phrases do not govern agreement.

strong_near_duplicate_pairs.reason: Both are two-clause subject-verb agreement checks with a singular subject beside a plural noun in a near-phrase, then a plural subject beside a singular noun in a near-phrase. The solver ignores the neighboring noun and chooses the singular/plural verb pair.

Both use a short consecutive-integer domain, a monotone inequality, and a requested extremal satisfying value. The solver finds the threshold and selects the boundary integer from nearby offered values.

overall: All ten items are answerable with a unique correct option. All four choices in each item are distinct and function as meaningful alternatives.
